data.body:
**[P1] Enforce compatibility for layer-loaded plugins**

This required peer only protects installations where core and OTel share one npm tree. In the documented Lambda-layer flow, OTel is installed separately and still advertises plugin API version 1, so core 2.6 will load OTel 1.2 without validating this range and silently omit the LMI header. Add a runtime provider capability/version gate that old core rejects while core 2.7 accepts, preserve an OTel-only layer packaging path, and test separate module trees.
